test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Nov 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The erroneous spelling is **Prevelent.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Among the given options the incorrectly spelled word is **‘prevelent’.**

 
 
• The correctly spelled word is **‘Prevalent’. Prevalent** is an adjective that means generally or widely accepted practiced or favored.
 
• **Example:** *Social media use is so **prevalent** in teens that they are becoming lazy and inactive.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct option is** option 3.**
